files.description_zh: 方案封面：以品牌的平行感知线与开放节点语法，把 AI 开启与 AI 关闭两条完全等价的服务线并列呈现，线上十个节点对应十个独立完成点，其中三个彩色开放节点标示三处重点区域。图内标注概念建议 / CONCEPT。
files.description_en: Proposal cover: using the brand's parallel sensory lines and open-node grammar, it places the AI-ON and AI-OFF service lines side by side as exact equivalents, with ten nodes standing for the ten independent-completion points and three coloured open nodes marking the three key areas. Labelled 概念建议 / CONCEPT on the image.

files.description_zh: 2 分 34 秒中文导览：城市智能的检验标准、AI 开启与关闭的服务等价、一条底线与三座实验院的空间骨架、三区两翼分工、十个独立完成点的评价意义，以及概念性质与边界声明。旁白由系统语音合成，无真人录音、无音乐、无实地录音。
files.description_en: A 2-minute-34-second Chinese guide covering the test of urban intelligence, service equivalence between AI ON and AI OFF, the spatial framework of one accessible spine and three sensory labs, the roles of the three areas and two wings, the evaluative purpose of the ten independent-completion points, and the conceptual scope and limits. Fully synthetic speech: no human recording, no music, no field audio.

files.title_zh: 万感京张 多模态短片（中文旁白 · 中英双语标注）
files.title_en: Every Sense Jing-Zhang multimodal short film (Chinese narration, bilingual on-screen labels)
files.description_zh: 63 秒短片，七个镜头：片头主题、总体结构与三处重点区、骨架与等价服务网络、三处重点区的人尺度运行合同、第 16 章交互场景的逐帧实录、品牌语法与文化底线、片尾边界声明。交互段实录连续呈现「播放引导流光」与「切换 AI 关闭」两次真实操作，切换前后十个独立完成节点的位置、以及已声明覆盖读数 10 / 10、2、3 / 3 完全不变（声明完整度，非现场绩效）。中文合成旁白，画面关键标注中英双语，中文字幕既烧录在画面上也提供外挂 WebVTT。无真人录音、无音乐、无实拍、无第三方素材、无生成式影像。
files.description_en: A 63-second film in seven shots: title, overall structure and the three key areas, the framework and equivalent service network, the human-scale operating contracts of the three key areas, a frame-accurate capture of the chapter-16 interactive scene, the brand grammar and cultural baseline, and the closing scope statement. The captured sequence performs two real interactions — play the guidance flow, then switch to AI OFF — after which the ten independent-completion nodes and the service readout of 10 / 10, 2 and 3 / 3 remain unchanged. Synthetic Chinese narration, bilingual on-screen labels, Chinese captions both burnt in and supplied as WebVTT. No human recording, no music, no live-action footage, no third-party assets, no generative imagery.

files.description_zh: 1 秒=20 米：AI 开启段 15.31 秒行进音走完 306.210 米到达；AI 关闭段按接口固定口径没有一米可走——开场即静默，静默即数据里接口缺失之处。纯程序合成+预置合成旁白，映射规则与档案 v0.4.0 读数逐项可核
files.description_en: One second per twenty metres: the AI-on walk completes 306.210 m in 15.31 s; with AI off the fixed-interface rule leaves not one walkable metre — silence from the very start, and the silence is where the data holds no interface. Program synthesis plus preset synthetic narration; the mapping replays item by item against archive v0.4.0

files.title_zh: 三区片区策略：街块诊断、开放化候选、界面规则、强度包络与走廊接驳判据（只登记关系与判据，不登记法定控制值）
files.title_en: District strategy for the three key areas: block diagnosis, opening candidates, frontage rules, intensity envelope and corridor/interchange criteria (relations and criteria only, no statutory control value)

files.title_zh: 三区方案 B 登记：每处重点区一个可辩的替代空间组合与一组三元决策条件（继续选 A／切换 B／两者均放弃），逐条标注即时可判与须预注册后可判两类，不预先给出任何阈值数值
files.title_en: Plan B register for the three key areas: one arguable alternative spatial combination per area with a three-way decision rule (keep A / switch to B / abandon both), every condition marked immediate or pre-registered, and no threshold value given in advance

files.title_zh: 外部情景矩阵：三条世界分岔（AI 廉价普及、强监管收缩、人工服务劳动力短缺）各自的不变量、可变项与退出条件，退出条件全部即时可判，另登记三条不予收录的分岔与理由
files.title_en: External scenario matrix: three ways the world could diverge (AI everywhere and nearly free, regulation tightening, a shortage of people to staff the service) with the invariants, adjustable components and exit condition of each, all exit conditions immediately decidable, plus three excluded branches with the reasons for exclusion

files.title_zh: 条件化制度载体谱系：五类发起主体（属地政府平台、场地与园区运营方、高校联合体、社会组织联合、多方联合体）各给触发条件，沿 A 角色归属、G3 复核席任命路径、回避规则、经费来源与底线暴露面、审批路径五条轴逐类展开配置差异；全部条目状态为 unknown，闭合的是格式空白而非主体空白，不点名任何真实机构、企业、高校或社会组织
files.title_en: Conditional institutional scaffold: five classes of sponsor (a local government platform body, a site or campus operator, a university consortium, a civil-society alliance, a multi-party consortium), each with its trigger and its configuration along five axes — where the accountable role sits, how the G3 review seat is appointed, recusal, the funding source with the exposure it creates on the floor, and the approval route; every entry unknown in status, closing the blank in the format and not the blank in the subject, and naming no real institution, company, university or civil-society body

files.title_zh: 五年财政结构模型：建设、年度运维、人力、采购模式四科目对公共财政全担、场地方承担、技术供应商承担、混合分担四种承担机制，各给激励、风险与对底线三项承诺（可见性、值守、预算）的威胁路径；推出「底线三项须逐项指定单一承担方、不得按比例分摊」一条配置要求；全文零金额、零单价、零比例、零分摊系数、零增长率，不可比较者登记 unknown
files.title_en: Five-year finance structure model: four accounts (construction, annual operation, labour, procurement mode) set against four bearing mechanisms (full public funding, the site party, the technology supplier, a mixed arrangement), each with its incentives, risks and specific threat path to the three non-AI channel floor commitments of visibility, staffing and budget; it derives one configuration requirement, that each floor item has a single named bearer and none is split by proportion; it carries no amount, unit price, ratio, apportionment coefficient or growth rate, and registers as unknown what cannot be so expressed

files.title_zh: 概念详图设想要素登记：三张概念推演图逐要素的既有判据来源、数据与设想的划分，以及一处已识别设计张力的处置判据（只登记判据来源与划分，不提出工程参数，也不构成法定结论）
files.title_en: Concept-design register: for each speculative element on the three concept sheets, the existing criterion it rests on, the line between data and speculation, and the disposal criteria for one identified design tension (registration only; no engineering parameter and no statutory conclusion)

files.title_zh: 零授权现场验证计划：六项空间读数的执行办法、无障碍路径实测协议与最小访谈集（计划已备，执行暂缓待辖区合规确认，全部读数仍为零值或 unknown）
files.title_en: Zero-authorisation field verification plan: execution method for the six spatial readings, the accessibility-route test protocol and the minimum interview set (plan ready, execution deferred pending jurisdictional compliance confirmation, every reading still zero or unknown)

files.title_zh: 三片区概念详图 CD-01：贯通通道、接口连续与服务桌落位的一次空间组合，三分幅同取向同比例尺（中英双语同图；概念推演，不基于权属、红线或测绘资料）
files.title_en: District concept detail CD-01 — one spatial composition of through-route, interface continuity and the service desk, three panels at one shared scale and orientation, one bilingual sheet (concept speculation, resting on no tenure, red-line or survey data)

files.title_en: Transport system concept CT-02 — rail access, corridor segmentation, cycling and the time separation of support vehicles, one bilingual sheet (solid marks data-derived, dashed marks speculation)

files.title_zh: 蓝绿系统概念图 CB-03：汇水概念分区、排水类型、遮荫与夜间照明分级，并写出一处已识别设计张力（中英双语同图；实线为数据派生，虚线为概念设想）
files.title_en: Blue-green system concept CB-03 — conceptual catchments, drainage types, shading and the night-lighting grades, with one identified design tension stated on the sheet, one bilingual sheet (solid marks data-derived, dashed marks speculation)

files.title_zh: 感官设计准则：蓝绿雨洪三层判据、十节点参数区间与母版口径、百年遗产解说序列与材料判据、实施制度框架、五×五参与矩阵（只登记判据与关系，不登记工程参数与法定控制值）
files.title_en: Sensory design code: the blue-green three-layer and stormwater criteria, the node parameter ranges and their master-card caliber, the century heritage interpretation sequence with its material criteria, the delivery-institution framework and the five-by-five participation matrix (criteria and relations only, no engineering parameter and no statutory control value)

files.title_zh: 蓝绿三层结构与节点雨洪类型 BG-01：三条层带、三条层间关系判据与十节点铺装径流去向类型（中英双语同图）
files.title_en: Blue-green three-layer structure and node drainage types BG-01 — three layer bands, three inter-layer criteria and the paving-runoff type of each of the ten nodes, one bilingual sheet

files.title_zh: 百年遗产解说序列 HS-01：自北向南三段叙事、绑定节点与地标、既有解说载体与四条遗存材料再利用判据（中英双语同图）
files.title_en: Century heritage interpretation sequence HS-01 — three strands from north to south, their bound nodes and landmarks, the carriers already delivered and four remnant-material reuse criteria, one bilingual sheet
